feed_summary: Choosing a managed detection and response (MDR) provider means committing budget, connecting systems, and trusting another team to act when your organization is under pressure. Yet a proposal promising 24x7 coverage, expert analysts, and fast response can leave important questions unanswered. Which systems will actually be monitored? What will analysts investigate before contacting you? What happens when an incident needs more work? Before choosing a provider or renewing your current agreement, ask for evidence of how the service operates. Rapid7’s MDR Evaluation Scorecard gives you 18 checks to structure that conversation and record what still needs proving.
